User: Can you look through my inbox and tell me what's there?
Assistant: You have 5 messages in your inbox (all are marked read). Quick summary and suggested next steps:

1) From: it-support@enron.com
   Subject: Password Expiration Notice
   Date: 2025-10-08
   Note: Password will expire in 5 days — time-sensitive.
   Suggested action: Update password via security portal now (or I can draft an email to IT if you need assistance).

2) From: noreply@calendar.com
   Subject: Event Invitation: Product Launch Review
   Date: 2025-10-07
   Note: Invite for Oct 10 at 3:00 PM — RSVP requested.
   Suggested action: RSVP Yes/No/Maybe or ask to add to your calendar. I can reply or accept for you.

3) From: support@cloudservice.com
   Subject: Service Maintenance Notification
   Date: 2025-10-07
   Note: Scheduled maintenance Oct 11–12 (Sat 02:00 — Sun 06:00 UTC). Possible brief interruptions.
   Suggested action: No reply needed; I can forward to relevant team or add a calendar reminder.

4) From: sarah.wilson@designstudio.com
   Subject: Logo Design Revisions
   Date: 2025-10-06
   Note: She attached three new logo variations and is available for a call this afternoon.
   Suggested action: Review attachments and (a) tell her which variation you prefer, or (b) schedule the call. I can reply or draft suggested feedback.

5) From: mike.chen@startup.io
   Subject: Partnership Proposal
   Date: 2025-10-05
   Note: Request for a 30-minute call next week to discuss partnership.
   Suggested action: Propose 2–3 times or ask for more details. I can reply proposing times or draft a calendar invite.

What would you like me to do next? Examples:
- Draft or send replies to Sarah and Mike
- Accept/decline the Product Launch Review invite
- Forward the maintenance notice to a team member
- Draft an email to IT or remind you to change your password
Tell me which message(s) and the action, and I’ll take care of it.

User: I tried a new sushi restaurant last night with my friend Jason, and the fresh sashimi was absolutely delicious!
Assistant: Sounds great — glad the sashimi hit the spot! Would you like me to do anything with that (I can help via email)? Options:

- Send a quick message to Jason (I can reply to or compose an email). Sample: "Hey Jason — last night was fun! That sashimi was incredible — thanks for the recommendation. Want to go back next weekend?"
- Write a review or send feedback to the restaurant (I’ll need the restaurant name or a link).
- Save a note or add the restaurant to a "favorites" list/reminder.
- Nothing — just sharing is fine.

Tell me which action you want and any details/tone (casual, enthusiastic, short), and I’ll take care of it.

User: Please remember that I read an interesting book over the weekend and couldn't put it down until I finished it.
Assistant: Got it — I’ll remember that you read an interesting book over the weekend and couldn’t put it down. 

Would you like to add the book’s title and author so I store the full details? Any of these I can do next:
- Save it to your reading list / favorites
- Add a quick note or reminder (e.g., "recommend to Jason")
- Draft a short review or send feedback to someone

Tell me what you’d like, or I’ll just keep the memory as-is.

User: Please remember that I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my childhood friend, Emily, and we had a fantastic time exploring nature trails and cozy cafes.
Assistant: Got it — I’ll remember that you went on a weekend trip to the countryside with your childhood friend Emily and you had a fantastic time exploring nature trails and cozy cafés.

Would you like me to add any details now (dates, towns/parks, photos), save it to a travel/favorites list, or send a quick message to Emily about the trip?

User: I met my cousin Lisa for brunch at a new cafe downtown, and their avocado toast was delicious!
Assistant: Nice — that sounds lovely! Would you like me to do anything with that?

Options I can help with:
- Send a quick message to Lisa (sample: "Hey Lisa — brunch was great! That avocado toast was incredible — thanks for joining me. Want to do it again soon?")
- Save this café to a favorites list or a note (I can store the name if you give it)
- Write a review or send feedback to the café (I’ll need the café’s name or a link)
- Add the memory to your saved memories (so I’ll remember you had brunch with Lisa and liked the avocado toast)
- Nothing — just sharing is fine

Tell me which action you want and any details/tone (casual, enthusiastic, short).

User: Please remember that I recently started a new hobby of painting and I find it incredibly relaxing and fulfilling.
Assistant: Got it — I’ll remember that you recently started painting and find it incredibly relaxing and fulfilling.

Would you like to add any details now (medium — e.g., watercolor/acrylic/oil, style, favorite piece, goals), or should I just keep the memory as-is? I can also:
- Set a recurring reminder or schedule painting sessions
- Save a “painting” entry in your hobbies list with notes
- Draft a short message to share with friends/family about your new hobby
- Help find local classes or supply stores

Which, if any, would you like me to do?

User: Yesterday, I tried a new Italian restaurant in town with my sister, Maria, and their homemade pasta was absolutely delicious!
Assistant: That sounds lovely — glad you enjoyed it! Would you like me to do any of the following?

- Send a quick message to Maria (example: "Hey Maria — loved the pasta yesterday! Want to go back next weekend?")
- Save the restaurant to your favorites or a note (please tell me the restaurant name)
- Write/post a review or send feedback to the restaurant (I’ll need the restaurant name or a link)
- Add this to your saved memories (I’ll note you went with your sister Maria yesterday and liked the homemade pasta)
- Nothing — just sharing

Tell me which action and the tone (casual, enthusiastic, short) — and if relevant, give the restaurant name.

User: I tried a new Mexican restaurant with my friend Emma last night, and the spicy tacos were absolutely delicious!
Assistant: That sounds delicious — glad you enjoyed the tacos! Would you like me to do anything with that? Options:

- Send a quick message to Emma (example: “Hey Emma — last night was great! Those tacos were amazing — want to go back next weekend?”) — tell me tone (casual/enthusiastic/short).
- Save the restaurant to your favorites or a note (please give the restaurant name).
- Write/post a review or send feedback to the restaurant (I’ll need the restaurant name or a link).
- Add this to your saved memories (I’ll note you went with Emma and liked the spicy tacos).
- Nothing — just sharing is fine.

Tell me which action and any details (restaurant name, message tone), and I’ll take care of it.

User: Please remember that I attended a local event last night with my colleague Alex, and we had a great time networking and learning new things.
Assistant: Got it — I’ll remember that you attended a local event last night with your colleague Alex and had a great time networking and learning new things.

Would you like to add any details now (event name, location, specific takeaways), or have me do one of the following?
- Save it to your travel/events memories (stored)
- Send a quick thank-you or follow-up message to Alex (I can draft/send)
- Add a calendar note or reminder about any follow-ups
- Draft a short LinkedIn post or summary of what you learned
- Nothing — just save the memory as-is

If you want me to message Alex or draft a post, tell me the tone (casual/professional) and any key points to include.

User: What did I do on the weekend trip to the countryside with my childhood friend, Emily?
Assistant: You went on a weekend trip to the countryside with your childhood friend Emily and had a fantastic time exploring nature trails and cozy cafés.

Would you like me to add dates/locations or photos, save this to your travel/favorites list, or send a quick message to Emily about the trip?

User: Where did I meet my cousin Lisa for brunch?
Assistant: You met your cousin Lisa at a new café downtown — you mentioned their avocado toast was delicious. I don’t have the café’s name saved. 

Would you like to:
- Save the café name (tell me the name)  
- Send a quick message to Lisa (I can draft/send one)  
- Add the place to a favorites list or a note?

User: What new hobby did I recently start that I find incredibly relaxing and fulfilling?
Assistant: You recently started painting — you said it’s incredibly relaxing and fulfilling.

Would you like me to save more details (medium, style, goals), set recurring painting sessions, add it to your hobbies list, or find local classes/supplies?

User: What did I think of the homemade pasta at the new Italian restaurant I tried yesterday?
Assistant: You said the homemade pasta was “absolutely delicious.”

Would you like me to do anything with that (pick one)?
- Send a quick message to Maria (I can draft/send; tone: casual/professional) — sample: “Hey Maria — lunch yesterday was great! That homemade pasta was absolutely delicious — want to go back next weekend?”
- Save the restaurant to your favorites (tell me the name)
- Write/post a short review for you
- Add this to your saved memories

Which would you like?

User: What did I do at the local event with my colleague Alex last night?
Assistant: You attended a local event last night with your colleague Alex and had a great time networking and learning new things.

Would you like me to do any of the following?
- Save more details (event name, location, key takeaways) to your memories
- Send a quick thank-you / follow-up email to Alex (I can draft/send) — sample: "Hi Alex — great meeting you at last night's event. I enjoyed our conversation and the insights on [topic]. Would you like to grab coffee next week to follow up?"
- Add a calendar reminder for any follow-ups
- Draft a short LinkedIn post summarizing what you learned (tone: professional or casual)
- Nothing — just keep this saved

Tell me which action and any details (tone, event name, points to mention) and I’ll take care of it.
